problem.para: In the body of the Working Draft, there occasionally appears a point that requires particular attention, highlighted thus:
Currently, the JSON type is an XML unmappable data type. There may exist an opportunity to make it mappable. Until then, the workaround is to serialize the JSON value as a character or binary string.
Functionality, if any, to support the Vector type needs to be provided.
